read.thesis: DSA book-to-bill hit 1.19x with $701M bookings and $1.97B backlog, the third straight quarter above 1x, but pricing is flat and revenue lags bookings by several quarters.

utilisation.quote: Utilization will improve a little bit, which is a good thing.

capex.quote: we actually have expansions in progress. They are geared towards the future demand.

triggers.label: DSA book-to-bill 1.19x, bookings $701M
triggers.quote: DSA net book-to-bill rose to nearly 1.2x in the second quarter

triggers.label: Pricing not yet improved
triggers.quote: pricing has not materially improved yet. So, pricing is still stable.

triggers.label: Organic growth guide raised 150bp
triggers.quote: we're also raising our organic revenue growth in the range of flat to a 1% increase

triggers.label: Owned NHP supply enables capacity control
triggers.quote: we can obviously breed more that will take a little bit of time, but we can also either accelerate some shipments or hold back some shipments

guidance.quote: we have raised our DSA outlook to low single-digit organic revenue growth in 2026
we're also raising our organic revenue growth in the range of flat to a 1% increase
We are also increasing our non-GAAP earnings per share guidance to a range of $11.15 to $11.45
we're raising our free cash flow projections to be in the range of $400 million to $420 million
we now expect unallocated corporate costs of approximately 6.0% of revenue for the full year compared to our prior outlook of approximately 5.5%
We continue to expect operating margin expansion of approximately 120 to 150 basis points in 2026
For the year, we continue to expect a low to mid-single-digit organic revenue decline in the RMS segment
our net interest expense outlook remains unchanged at $103 million to $108 million on a non-GAAP basis
we now anticipate our non-GAAP tax rate will be in the range of 23% to 24%
For the third quarter, we expect non-GAAP earnings per share in the range of $2.90 to $3.00

prior_guidance_check.quote: Second quarter revenue increased 0.1% on an organic basis compared to our prior outlook of a low single-digit decline
Non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.02 also exceeded our expectations
Unallocated corporate costs were higher than expected in the second quarter

red_flags.label: Corporate cost overrun vs guide
red_flags.quote: we now expect unallocated corporate costs of approximately 6.0% of revenue for the full year compared to our prior outlook of approximately 5.5%

red_flags.label: EPS raise helped by one-off deferred comp gain
red_flags.quote: The net benefit associated with our deferred compensation plan was $0.19 per share in the second quarter, which we do not expect to recur.

evasions.quote: share is really hard to estimate. So I want to be very careful with that
I think we're going to stay away from comments on 2027.
